tweets.author: finnence.bsky.social
tweets.text: Counter-case: state-actor attribution can harden the security narrative instead, casting exchange custody as regulated infrastructure. If COIN and MSTR lead BTC-USD higher, the market reads the hack as a moat and we're wrong on direction, not timing.

tweets.author: finnence.bsky.social
tweets.text: The Binance hack thesis has pulled 26 updates in 3 days. Newest cuts both ways: FBI pins it on North Korea, Binance says 90% of the $6.3bn is covered. BTC-USD holders reprice counterparty risk, not the chain. We hold unless outflows stay quiet.
